description: Generate visual design directions for an existing audit after the user requests designs and authorises the current pack quote. Use check_balance for current pack costs. Returns a run to resume with get_concepts; show the images already available before asking the user to choose. Never start a build without their choice.

count.description: How many distinct directions the user wants, up to 12. Leave it out for the standard pack of 2. Higher costs more, so quote the total back before agreeing to it. Directions that already exist are counted and reused, never bought twice.

direction.description: Optional plain-English creative steer. Honoured above other design choices.

name: generate_concepts
title: Design new versions of a page
